acceptanceCriteria: status/verify accept a map path outside the repository (or help documents the layout); out-of-tree anchor/verdict-ledger mode delivered or explicitly deferred to a follow-up ticket with the limit recorded; spec amended; tests.
body: GitHub beamfall/corvint#1329. assemble-stable requires its output outside the repository, while cem status/verify --map refuse absolute paths (map path must be repository-relative) and help does not say so; anchor --artifacts and the verdict ledger only work for committed maps.
title: cem status/verify refuse out-of-repository maps that assemble-stable must write outside the repository
